{{Top|leg}}
{{Nickname}}
"'''The program'''" was the informal name of an experiment started by [[Melen Toobo]], the head of the [[Coruscant Wildlife Management Department]], to domesticate [[Coruscani ogre]]s using [[Lobotomy|lobotomies]] and [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implants]]. After several [[Standard month/Legends|months]], the program was able to create a partial success with an ogre nicknamed "[[Friendly]]." However, when other ogres were put through the same process, they became violent and uncontrollable. After this the program was halted, although it was restarted under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LO">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030501ogre|series=Creature Feature|text=Lobotomized Ogre}}</ref>
